expectation: Membrane ring on plasmacytoid dendritic cells. These are rare, scattered single cells, or small groups in the stroma, in immune infiltrates and around lymphoid aggregates or vessels. They should not appear in tumour epithelium. Expect a few dozen to a few hundred cells per image.
observed: A: many tiles show diffuse yellow haze that follows the epithelial and tissue texture. Tiles 3, 7, 11 and 12 also have scattered small bright dots, densest in the immune-rich, nucleus-dense tile 12. B and C: grain that tracks the tissue, with no distinct cells. D: blobs at the edge, with no clear ring.
why: Scattered bright single cells concentrate in immune-rich tiles as pDCs would, but strong haze that follows the tissue texture dominates, and D shows no crisp membrane cells.
notes: Several tiles hold scattered small bright cells in immune-rich stroma, which fits pDCs. Strong haze following the epithelial texture lowers the contrast, and the close-up shows no clear membrane ring.
